Great food and very nice hosts
Mar 2026 • Couples
It is worth finding this restaurant! Turning off the main road, a rather narrow path leads towards Botanica Spa, the sunset is also signposted at the turnoff. The small path is safe and leads along a few residential buildings. It is worth turning off from the main road! A beautiful farm under a large mango tree, a warm host family and very delicious food. It's fast and everything is freshly prepared!! Whether chicken skewers, seafood basket (speciality) or lobster, everything up to the mango pancake was extremely delicious. The price/performance ratio is great, everything is very clean. We stayed here several times and everything was very good! A family business at its finest, standing out from the restaurants on the main street.

Valued, value, valuable!
Jul 2025 • Solo
The setting alone is good reason to eat here. It’s right on the beach, yet private from the crowds. The sound of waves breaking compliments your experience. 
But that’s just the start. I visited several times during my time in Mui Ne and struggled to try everything that looked desirable. I was never disappointed with a dish, most exceeded my expectations. 
But the best thing about Sunset is the staff. I was made to feel welcome and comfortable, but more… valued. 
Your money goes a long way here. Considering the service, it is truly exceptional! (Just saying)

Sunset Restaurant Delights
Apr 2025 • Couples
Located in an inner courtyard away from the noise of the street, this restaurant has an authentic and relaxing charm. Very well received by the boss we were delighted by the setting, hospitality and delicious meal. We discovered this very good restaurant at the end of our stay but we were able to go twice.
